start.name: Abu Madi onshore gas treatment facility / field, Nile Delta, Egypt (exact facility location not independently public/geocodable)
start.coord_basis: No public source gives a specific coordinate or named locality for the Abu Madi treatment facility/field, distinct from the wider 'Abu Madi' geological formation (which also underlies unrelated fields, e.g. the offshore Baltim Southwest field, per Egypt Oil & Gas's Nile Delta guide). OSM/Nominatim has no matching populated place or POI named Abu Madi in the Nile Delta (the only 'Abu Madi' hit is an unrelated 'Bir Abu Madi' locality in Matrouh Governorate, far to the west, in the desert). Retry attempt: extracted the full Egypt Oil & Gas Feb-2020 Nile Delta guide PDF directly (pdftotext) and confirmed it separately tables an 'Abu Madi-Damietta' pipeline (Abu Madi -> Damietta, 42 km, 16in) alongside Abu Madi-Talkha I (35km) and II (35km) -- a third independent distance constraint from the SAME source. Used the two distances (35km from Talkha [31.39211,31.06225], 42km from Damietta [31.8144,31.4165, Wikipedia city-center]) to compute a circle-intersection triangulation: this yields two mathematically valid candidate points ~48km apart (approx 31.759E/31.042N and 31.375E/31.377N). The second is the more geographically plausible one (inland Kafr El Sheikh/Dakahlia border area, consistent with the guide's description of Abu Madi as the onshore hub receiving gas from coastal/offshore Nile Delta fields), but both distances trace to one single publication (not independently corroborated by a second outlet the way the Faramid bearing was), so the two-fold ambiguity can only be broken by plausibility, not citation -- too speculative to adopt as a confident coordinate under the no-fabrication rule. Held at null. A human with EGPC/Petrobel facility maps, or higher-resolution satellite/OSM tagging of the Kafr El Sheikh/Dakahlia coastal strip, should be able to resolve this quickly; the triangulated candidate above is offered as a lead, not an answer.

The same table's separate 'Abu Madi-Damietta' row (42 km, 16 in) is new context from this retry, used only for the (unadopted) triangulation attempt above.
notes: RETRY RESULT: still unresolved, no geometry staged. END point (Talkha) remains well anchored and unchanged. START point (Abu Madi): confirmed via direct PDF extraction of the Egypt Oil & Gas guide that Abu Madi is a real, well-documented onshore gas treatment facility (Petrobel/Eni-operated, discovered 1967, Egypt's first gas field) that receives gas from the Nooros and Baltim Southwest offshore fields and feeds pipelines to Talkha, Damietta, and El Gamil -- so this is a genuinely real, active hub, just still not independently geocodable from public sources (checked OSM/Nominatim in English and Arabic, Wikipedia, EGPC/Petrobel materials, industry press -- no named village/locality/facility pin exists). Attempted a circle-intersection triangulation from two published Abu Madi pipeline distances (see coord_basis) but the result has an unresolved two-fold ambiguity (two solutions ~48km apart, from a single non-independently-corroborated source) and was not adopted -- kept as a lead only. Set resolved:false; recommend a follow-up pass with access to EGPC/Petrobel internal facility maps or higher-resolution imagery of the Kafr El Sheikh/Dakahlia coastal strip.
